name: ESBE Incorporated
description: ESBE Incorporated is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit advancing veteran support and public-interest access to government-facing services.

tools.name: get_page_guide
tools.description: List ESBE Incorporated's public pages (home, donate, community, privacy, terms) with each page's title, description, URL, and last-updated date, from the site's own page catalog.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the full text of ESBE Incorporated's public pages (home, donate, community, privacy, terms) and return matching excerpts with the page each came from.

query.description: Search terms; every term must appear on a matching page

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one of ESBE Incorporated's public pages as markdown: /, /donate, /community, /privacy, or /terms. Returns the same markdown the site serves to agents at its .md URLs.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the visitor's browser to one of ESBE Incorporated's public pages: home (/), donate (/donate), community (/community), privacy (/privacy), or terms (/terms). Only these internal paths are used.

page.description: Page key or path: home, donate, community, privacy, terms — or the exact path like /donate
